name: quoting-others
description: People talk about each other in the third person and agree with someone who isn't there.
lines: As Priya said in her email, we should hold the release until the security review is done.
I agree with Priya on that, and Lee's team can't start the review until Monday anyway.
That's right, we're fully booked this week. Monday is the earliest we can do.
Okay. Sam, can you move the release date in the plan?
Yes, I'll update it after this.
